headline: Solid prime-angle SSE and offshore wind — this is the day.
today: Best conditions around: 3 to 3.6ft at 6s-plus from a prime SSE angle with cross-off to offshore N wind holding all day. It is clean and rideable on everything from shortboard to fish, just mind the low-tide windows around 4:34p. Rearrange your morning for this one.

daysToWatch.note: Prime-angle 6.7s SSE still in the 3ft range with light W wind at dawn. Another clean one — get on it early before the SW cross-on creeps in.
Bigger short-period pulse up to 3.9ft at a prime angle, but cross-on wind most of the day. The NW cross-off in the evening could clean it up for a late session.
Plenty of size at 3.5ft but 19-21mph E/ESE cross-on wind trashes it. Big and messy — expectations low.
